slots.name: Hex Crow
slots.description: A crow climbs over your target, caws to mark the spot and dives. Perched, it pecks them and marks them for Grasp; Nyxxie's next hit pops it. Dash at the caw to dodge; shield or air dodge to swat it off.

slots.name: Bat Scatter
slots.description: Nyx bursts into bats, flies where you point and re-forms. Her recovery.

slots.name: Grasp
slots.description: On a target carrying your crow, a shadow hand rises under them and drags them to your feet. Without a crow, a shadow hand bursts up right in front of you and pops them into the air.

slots.name: Going Live
slots.description: Nyx lets loose and goes live as Nyxxie: a pink flash pulls nearby enemies in.

slots.description: Nyxxie raises her phone and charges the ring light, then flashes it across mid-range. Anyone facing her is dazzled for a rush in. Look away to dodge it.

slots.description: Ring light rotor chops during the rise, then pops victims up and away.

slots.name: Selfie Grab
slots.description: Nyxxie lunges in, poses for a selfie with them, and the flash blasts them away. Beats shields.
